verses: A Ma῾alot Poem of David. If not for the Lord who was with us, let Yisra᾽el now say –
if not for the Lord who was with us, when men rose up against us:
then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their anger was kindled against us:
then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul:
then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
Blessed be the Lord, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
Our soul is escaped like a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
